verdict.rationale: Evidence shows domain-level isolation building blocks — Domain Sending Keys scoped per domain (mailgun-docs-17), per-domain suppression handling for bounces/unsubscribes/complaints (mailgun-docs-12, mailgun-docs-34), and IP pool management for reputation (mailgun-docs-11, mailgun-docs-29) — and a community user confirms real-world tenant isolation via 'separate domains, dedicated IPs' (mailgun-comm-12). However, there is no explicit documentation of a formal subaccount/subuser feature for platform-level tenant management. Missing for 10: explicit subaccount/subuser API or docs, confirmation that suppression lists are fully isolated per domain/tenant, and independent verification of reputation isolation across tenants.
